finalPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: V3 visual approval sample for a photorealistic Unity first-person shotgun muzzle blast. Input image: the provided Shotgun Muzzle Flash V3 image is the edit target. Primary request: Strengthen this same V3 effect by making the blast substantially larger, denser, fuller, and more spectacular. This is not a new V4 design. Keep it unmistakably the same V3 shotgun discharge, but increase the visible scale and layered visual mass. Required changes: Keep the compact muzzle attachment origin at the same far-left point and the rightward firing direction. Enlarge the overall blast envelope by roughly 25% in apparent mass: a broader vertical fan immediately after the muzzle and a fuller forward reach, while keeping the complete effect inside the landscape frame with clear margins and no cropped tips. Enlarge the brilliant white-hot ignition core by about 40% and surround it with thicker incandescent yellow-gold pressure layers. Increase the number and thickness of irregular branching golden-yellow, deep amber, vivid hot-orange, and burnt-orange flame sheets by roughly 1.8x. Fill the fan more densely while preserving broken organic gaps and asymmetry. Add substantially more separate volumetric hot-gas lobes at different apparent depths, never a single flat triangle or uniform cone. Increase charcoal-gray and warm dark brown-gray powder-smoke volume and density above, below, and behind the flame sheets. Keep fine curling smoke texture and translucent edges so it reads as layered volume, not a solid black blob. Roughly double the visible orange-gold sparks, embers, and powder flecks, including energetic particles breaking beyond the outer fan edges. Preserve and intensify the current white -> yellow-gold -> amber/orange -> dark smoke color hierarchy and strong local contrast. The final result should feel like a forceful, cinematic heavy shotgun discharge with much greater pressure, heat, debris, depth, and spectacle, while remaining physically plausible and photorealistic. Preserve: the current realistic combustion rendering style; the left-origin/rightward shotgun fan identity; the intense non-neon color palette; the existing baked light checker presentation background appearance; landscape aspect ratio and clean framing. Avoid: bomb-like spherical explosion, round fireball, mushroom cloud, fantasy magic, neon colors, red-only palette; flamethrower stream, rocket exhaust, long narrow jet, smooth uniform triangle, flat sprite/card appearance; gun, hands, person, scenery, text, logo, watermark, border; clipped flames, clipped smoke, clipped particles, or loss of the muzzle attachment point.
